Therefore the coordinate product topology and Euclidean topology agree, justifying the box compactness/interior/closedness interpretations in S002. D006 separately supplies the measure identification.

grounds.reason: n is a finite dimension.
Standard Euclidean structures are fixed.
D006 explicitly fixes the corresponding coordinate-product measure.
The very same coordinate box Q is used for M014 and M013.
